preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 3
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 3) representing the number of test cases.
Each test case starts with a line containing five integers N, K, X, M, S (2 ≤ K ≤ N ≤ 10^5, 0 ≤ M ≤ 10^5, 1 ≤ S ≤ N, 1 ≤ X ≤ 10^9) separated by spaces.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(a) <= N and 1 <= int(b) <= N and int(a) != int(b) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1+T:] for a, b, c in [line.split()[:3]])
preconditions.description: Each of the M lines for newer roads contains three integers a_i, b_i, c_i (1 ≤ a_i, b_i ≤ N, a_i ≠ b_i, 1 ≤ c_i ≤ 10^9) representing a road between cities a_i and b_i with length c_i.
Each newer road is specified by exactly three integers (a_i, b_i, c_i).

preconditions.expression: all(int(a) != int(b) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1+T:] for a, b, c in [line.split()[:3]])
preconditions.description: No road connects a city to itself (a_i ≠ b_i).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(c) <= 10**9 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1+T:] for a, b, c in [line.split()[:3]])

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == N for output_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a single line containing exactly N integers, where N is the number of cities.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(dist) <= 10**18 for output_line in stdout.splitlines() for dist in output_line.split())
postconditions.description: Each distance in the output is a non-negative integer (≤ 10^18) representing the minimum total length of a path from city S to city i.

postconditions.expression: all(int(dist) == 0 for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if int(output_line.split()[S-1]) == 0)
postconditions.description: The distance from city S to itself is always 0.

postconditions.expression: all(int(dist) == min(sum(c_i for a_i, b_i, c_i in path) for path in all_paths) if all_paths else 0 for output_line in stdout.splitlines() for dist in output_line.split())
postconditions.description: For each city i, the output distance is the minimum total length of any path from city S to city i, where paths are sequences of roads connecting S to i. The graph is guaranteed to be connected, so a path always exists.

postconditions.expression: all(int(dist) <= int(dist2) for output_line in stdout.splitlines() for dist, dist2 in zip(output_line.split(), output_line.split()[1:])) if len(output_line.split()) > 1 else True
postconditions.description: The distances are computed correctly for all cities, including the old cities (1..K) which are fully connected with roads of length X.
